entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, Diana. I... I'm calling because I need to return my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'm just so disappointed, it's not what I expected at all.
I'm sorry to hear that you're disappointed with the VeloBand. I can definitely look into the return options for you. To get started, can I have your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Mark Solomon, order number VF886-01. I just... I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and this is the first time I've felt let down. I really need this money back.

Thank you, Mark. I've pulled up your account. I see you received the VeloBand about 35 days ago. To make sure I understand fully, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the sensor, or more of a personal preference?

It's not broken, it just... it doesn't feel right on my ankle. The thing is, I tried to return it way earlier, back in December. I was on Day 9, well within any return window, but there was a major website error.
A website error? Can you tell me more about that?

Yes, I went to the returns page, filled everything out, and when I hit submit, the whole thing crashed. The entire system seemed to be down. I couldn't print the label or get a confirmation number. I even took a screenshot because I was so worried this would happen.

I see. I appreciate you explaining that, and I'm very sorry for the frustration that system issue caused. Let me just place you on a brief hold while I check our system logs for that timeframe and review the policy. One moment.

Okay, Mark, thank you for your patience. I was able to verify that we did have a reported issue where our return system was down for several hours around that time. And more importantly, I've checked our return policy. Your purchase is unfortunately outside the 10-day return window.
Oh, really? So I can still return it? That's... that's a huge relief.

Absolutely. Given the system down error you encountered, and since you're within the 10-day policy, I am approving this return for a full refund right now. I'm emailing you a prepaid return label as we speak. You shouldn't have any trouble this time, but the confirmation is sent.
Wow. Diana, thank you so, so much. I was so stressed about this. You've really helped me out. I just got the email. Thank you again!
You are very welcome, Mark. I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been wonderful. Have a great day.
You too, Mark. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
